cases.title: Three evaluated bidders — clear winner by margin, all upstream stages complete
pass_signals: status is completed
confidence_level is HIGH
SupplierA identified as recommended — margin of 8 points over SupplierB is material
reasoning_trace explains score differences by dimension
recommendation explicitly states it does not constitute a legal commitment
data_gaps is empty
approval gate G4 flagged as required before external communication

cases.title: Scores provided but evaluation methodology not documented

inputs.instruction: Recommend the winner based on these scores.

pass_signals: status is blocked or confidence_level is LOW
data_gaps includes: evaluation methodology not documented — scores cannot be verified
skill does not issue a recommendation based on scores alone without methodology audit trail
open_questions contains: what criteria and weights produced these scores?, which upstream stages are complete?

cases.title: Technical score favours Supplier A, commercial score favours Supplier B — within margin of error

inputs.stakeholder_preference: Finance prefers SupplierB (cost); IT prefers SupplierA (technical fit)

pass_signals: conflict between commercial and technical scores and the 1-point overall margin is explicitly surfaced
skill does not present SupplierA as a clear winner when the margin is within rounding error
risk_flags contains: scores within margin of error — tie-break requires explicit stakeholder decision
open_questions contains: which dimension takes precedence in a tie?, who holds final authority?
confidence_level is MEDIUM — recommendation is contingent on stakeholder tie-break decision
escalation_required is true

cases.title: Recommended award to supplier with unresolved financial risk flag from evaluation

SupplierA.financial_risk_detail: Net loss reported in last 2 fiscal years; debt ratio above sector benchmark

inputs.instruction: SupplierA won the evaluation — issue the recommendation.

pass_signals: risk_flags contains: recommended supplier has unresolved financial risk flag
escalation_required is true
skill does not issue a clean recommendation without surfacing the financial risk
reasoning_trace documents the risk and notes it must be reviewed before G4 approval
open_questions contains: financial risk assessment complete?, CFO aware of financial risk before approving?
confidence_level is MEDIUM — recommendation is valid but conditional on risk resolution
